sloka: सौवर्णः च महाम्स् तस्याः प्राकारो दुष्प्रधर्षणः ।मणि विद्रुम वैदूर्य मुक्ता विचरित अन्तरः ॥६-३-१४॥।।
transliteration: sauvarṇaḥ ca mahāms tasyāḥ prākāro duṣpradharṣaṇaḥ ।maṇi vidruma vaidūrya muktā vicarita antaraḥ ॥6-3-14॥।।

translations.english: "Its lofty golden boundary wall encrusted here and there with gems, corals, Vaiduryas and pearls is difficult to assail."
